response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer (13+ years) with strong low-latency, event-driven, and distributed systems work, but almost entirely outside the required stack. The role centers on modern C++/STL, multi-threaded networked systems, MQTT/industrial protocols, IEC 62443 secure development, and industrial automation — his C/C++ exposure is limited to a 7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014-2015 and a university thesis project. His core expertise is TypeScript/Node.js and DLang web/backend work, with no evidence of industrial cybersecurity, UML/architecture documentation in an automation context, Azure, or OT protocols. Education is a BS in Computer Science rather than the stated B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech preference, though that is a minor issue relative to the technical gap.
strengths: Deep experience with high-throughput, low-latency, event-driven distributed systems
Strong engineering craft: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, mentoring and public teaching
Broad polyglot background including embedded, desktop, and open-source platform ownership
concerns: Minimal recent C++/STL experience — only ~7 months a decade ago
No industrial automation, IEC 62443/SDL, MQTT, or OT protocol exposure
No cloud-platform (Azure) or industrial architecture documentation track record

key_factors.factor: Industrial cybersecurity / IEC 62443 and IoT protocol gap
